entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State where the UE is not registered with the network and cannot access normal services.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to register with the network and transition to EMM-REGISTERED state.

entities.name: UE in EMM-DEREGISTERED state
entities.description: Condition where the UE is not registered and must initiate attach procedure for service access.

relations.description: When UE is in EMM-DEREGISTERED state, it must initiate the attach procedure.
Attach procedure is initiated when UE is in EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
